name: validation-upstream-eslint-plugin-unicorn
description: eslint-plugin-unicorn 76.0.0 as published, with the eslint and test-time packages its test files load (test/utils, scripts/parsers.js). Upstream commits no lockfile, so every package is the version npm resolved for upstream's package.json ranges on the day 76.0.0 was published (npm install --before=2026-09-19T11:29:51.054Z).
